title: ci: the "Fetch this commit's history and the base branch" step times out (8 to 20 min) on main pushes and merge groups, four times on 2026-11-16/17
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filing gate: ① a measured CI defect, seen four times in about five hours. It is not a test failure, so no queue-flake anchor files it.

## What happens

The step "Fetch this commit's history and the base branch" times out before any test runs, and the shard then publishes no attestation, so the whole leg goes red:

| when (UTC) | run | where | timeout |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-11-16 19:33 | push CI `6a7403ba` | Test Core 7/8 | 20 min |
| 2026-11-16 20:04 | merge group pr-34447 | Test Core 5/8 | 20 min |
| 2026-11-16 22:00 | merge group pr-34381 | Test UI 4/16 | 14 min |
| 2026-11-17 00:02 | merge group pr-34511 | Plan Test Core shards | 8 min |

Each time the next run on the same tree was green. Every hit on a merge group ejects that PR and costs everything queued behind it a rebuild.

## Why it matters

This is fleet throughput and CI spend. It is a fleet-efficiency card under the maintainer's 2026-11-16 rule (addendum 7 on #6015), so p2.

## Ask

Find why the fetch stalls: depth, the size of the base-branch fetch, or the runner's network. Make the step bounded and retried (for example a shallower fetch with one retry) before it can fail a leg. ⛔ Do not mark the leg optional.
